source.provider: IGN / INSEE - Contours IRIS WFS Géoplateforme

auditPolicy: Official WFS geometry and IDs are preserved. Contiguous suffix families are explicitly merged; ambiguous exact labels are explicitly accepted; technical numbering is resolved 1:1 only from official named places strictly contained in the source polygon. No city or source cell is abandoned.
